sets.policy: Fixed scan poses; separate rightmost-disc landmark only locates color samples and never moves score pixels. Fit first four UUIDs, validate remaining eight; median color-distance gain >0.25, worst reserved-card regression <=3.

Fixed scan poses. Retro uses the perimeter landmark; modern outlined discs use a fixed nominal 11.5px circle and only its 45–85% radius annulus for color (source disc center from renderer geometry), avoiding the outline and title frame. Neither moves score pixels. Fit first four UUIDs, validate remaining eight; median color-distance gain >0.25, worst reserved-card regression <=3.
